column1: # Which source paths each check covers, for `make recheck` (tools/check-record.py).
# Columns: check name globs (space separated), a tab, then path patterns. A pattern ending in /
# is a folder prefix, otherwise a glob on the whole path. A leading ! excludes. @name is a list
# defined below. For each check the first rule that fits gives its paths. Rules marked * are
# added to every check. A check no rule fits reruns every time.
# Keep it broad: a needless rerun costs time, a missed one hides a break. Any change under
# tests/, tools/ or vendor/ reruns everything, since test helpers, fixtures and Dynarmic are
# shared in ways the Makefile doesn't show. `tools/check-record.py audit` lists what the
# Makefile and #include say a check needs that this map misses; keep it at 0.
# The PXA and paravirtual files only the PXA devices run. pxa_IC, pxa_GPIO, pxa_I2C, pxa_I2S and
# pxa270_WMMX stay out of the list: the iMX1 code includes some of them.
